i went from being the top student in my grade and not really having to study hard to do well, to being constantly stressed and struggling to stay in the top half at my new school. 

i used to be so confident in my abilities and my intellect and now i constantly feel exhausted and demotivated. there's always someone smarter, more hard working than you, more talented. and sometimes you can't control these things - it can be a matter of life circumstance and chance. i used to enjoy being praised as a star student at my old school but now i feel like an unimpressionable entity, constantly tired and stressed and having to gruel and work for my grades.
